correctness.rationale: The least-unmatched-vertex recurrence exhausts all LCF perfect matchings; the independent nine-line permutation enumeration is exhaustive; an explicit graph isomorphism shows all 42 full adjacency sets agree. Simple six-cycles exhaustively enumerated and each legal matching flip tested. Component structure checked by degree-six hubs and low-degree induced C6 decomposition. Sign invariance has an analytic 3-cycle proof. Both self-contained verification programs succeeded.
